nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic (implementation) contract that the proxy delegatecalls into.
Constructor that stores the logic address and performs an initializing delegatecall with caller-supplied calldata.
Payable fallback that forwards all calldata via assembly delegatecall to the stored logic address.
delegatecall executed in the constructor with arbitrary _initializationCalldata against the logic contract; runs untrusted code in proxy storage context.
Raw assembly delegatecall in the fallback forwarding all gas and calldata to the logic address; external code executes in the proxy's storage context.
Constructor parameter holding the logic contract address, assigned to the immutable state variable logic.
Constructor parameter holding calldata passed to the delegatecall that initializes the logic contract.

edges.reason: The _logic constructor parameter is written into the immutable state variable logic.
The _initializationCalldata parameter is supplied directly as the calldata of the constructor delegatecall.
The constructor body executes the delegatecall to the logic contract for initialization.
The constructor assigns the logic state variable at deployment time.
The fallback body always reaches the assembly delegatecall, which forwards calldata to the logic contract.
The stored logic address is loaded and used as the delegatecall target in the fallback; the delegatecall forwards all remaining gas to externally supplied code, exposing the proxy to reentrant calls.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _logic only feeds the constructor's state assignment and delegatecall, so it can be normalized into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter _initializationCalldata is used solely as the calldata of the constructor delegatecall, so it can be normalized into that unsafe operation node.
